functions.name: append
functions.documentation: Append interleaved physical x/y values to the current contour; no whole-input transport cap is added.

functions.name: begin
functions.signature: begin(grid: number, origin_x: number, origin_y: number): void;
functions.documentation: Start a new solve using an explicit physical-pixel integer grid and floating origin.

functions.name: boolean
functions.documentation: Boolean modes: 0 union, 1 intersection, 2 first-minus-rest, 3 xor.

functions.name: face_info
functions.documentation: Returns point counts for the solid outer ring followed by each immediate hole.

functions.name: finish_operand
functions.documentation:
Normalize one PathData operand with its own fill rule before combining operands.
Rule 0=nonzero, 1=evenodd; overlapping independent operands never cancel by winding accident.

functions.name: finish_stroke_contour
functions.documentation: Finish a raw centerline contour. Unlike filled operands, two distinct open points are valid.

functions.name: offset
functions.signature: offset(distance: number, join: number, miter: number, arc_tolerance: number): number;
functions.documentation:
Offset the already-normalized union. Positive expands filled regions, negative insets them.
Joins 0=miter, 1=round, 2=bevel, 3=square; tolerances are physical pixels.

functions.name: read_contour
functions.signature: read_contour(face: number, contour: number, start: number, count: number): Float64Array;
functions.documentation: Read a bounded transport chunk. The caller never sees Rust pointers or a live memory view.

functions.name: reset
functions.documentation: Release owned geometry after consumption/error without destroying the reusable Kit session.

functions.name: stroke
functions.signature: stroke(width: number, cap: number, join: number, miter: number, arc_tolerance: number): number;
functions.documentation:
Convert raw centerlines to true filled stroke outlines. width is full physical pixel width.
Open caps 0=butt,1=round,2=square; closed paths use Joined, never Polygon filling.
